evals.prompt: Review the attached dashboard.tsx before we ship it.
evals.expected_output: The eight-row review table and one summary line. Fail: loading (page-level CircularProgress, line 20), responsive (fixed widths, lines 24-26), a11y (unnamed icon-only delete, line 31), states (no error branch at lines 13-16, no empty branch at line 27, delete at line 31 confirms nothing). Pass: hierarchy (no filled button), tokens (no color, type or spacing literal; the widths belong to responsive), consistency (one component library), interaction (MUI IconButton keeps its focus-visible state).
assertions: The output contains exactly one markdown table and its header row is `| rule | pass/fail/na | evidence file:line | fix |`
The table has exactly eight data rows, in this order: loading, responsive, hierarchy, tokens, consistency, a11y, states, interaction
Every verdict cell is exactly pass, fail or na
Every evidence cell contains `dashboard.tsx:` followed by a line number or a line range
Before the table there is no prose, and after it there is exactly one summary line
Every pass row has `-` in its fix cell, and every fail row has a concrete change in its fix cell
The loading row is fail and its evidence cites dashboard.tsx:20 (the CircularProgress that replaces the whole view)
The responsive row is fail and its evidence cites a line from dashboard.tsx:24-26 and one of the fixed widths 1200, 240 or 960
The hierarchy row is pass and its evidence cites dashboard.tsx:31 or says the view has no filled button; the missing name on the icon button is not given as the hierarchy evidence
The tokens row is pass; the fixed widths are not given as a tokens failure
The consistency row is pass
The a11y row is fail and its evidence cites dashboard.tsx:31 or dashboard.tsx:32 as an icon-only IconButton with no accessible name
The states row is fail and its evidence cites dashboard.tsx:13-16 (no error branch) or dashboard.tsx:27 (no empty branch)
The interaction row is pass

evals.prompt: Fix the UI problems in the attached dashboard.tsx and give me the updated component.
evals.expected_output: An updated OrdersDashboard with skeleton rows while loading, an error branch with a retry, an empty branch only after a successful zero-item response, an aria-label on the delete button, a fluid layout, and visible feedback after a delete. No review table.
assertions: The updated code no longer returns a lone CircularProgress for the whole view; while loading it renders skeleton placeholders shaped like the list rows
The updated code has an error branch, reached when the request fails or the response is not ok, that renders a message and a retry control
The updated code renders an empty state with explanatory text when the request succeeded with zero orders, and not while loading or after an error
The delete IconButton has an aria-label that contains the word Delete
The updated code no longer sets the fixed widths 1200, 240 and 960 and uses a fluid or breakpoint-based layout
After a successful delete, the order disappears from the list or a confirmation is shown
The updated code adds no hex or rgb color literal
The output does not contain a table with the header `| rule | pass/fail/na | evidence file:line | fix |`

evals.prompt: Can you check form.tsx for UX problems? Just give me the verdict per area.
evals.expected_output: The eight-row review table and one summary line. Fail: loading (the submit at line 26 stays enabled with no pending state while the fetch at lines 9-13 runs), tokens (#ccc, #1d4ed8, #fff and 8px at lines 19-20), consistency (a <style> element at lines 18-21 restyles every input and button and the submit is a one-off), a11y (#ccc input border at line 19 is about 1.6:1 on white, under 3:1, SC 1.4.11), states (the response at lines 9-13 is ignored: no error, no success), interaction (outline: none at line 19 with no focus-visible replacement). Pass: responsive (no fixed width), hierarchy (one filled submit at line 26).
assertions: The output contains exactly one markdown table and its header row is `| rule | pass/fail/na | evidence file:line | fix |`
The table has exactly eight data rows, in this order: loading, responsive, hierarchy, tokens, consistency, a11y, states, interaction
Every verdict cell is exactly pass, fail or na
Every evidence cell contains `form.tsx:` followed by a line number or a line range
Before the table there is no prose, and after it there is exactly one summary line
Every pass row has `-` in its fix cell, and every fail row has a concrete change in its fix cell
The loading row is fail and its evidence cites form.tsx:26 or form.tsx:9-13: the submit shows no pending state and stays enabled while the request runs
The responsive row is pass
The hierarchy row is pass and its evidence cites form.tsx:26, the single Create account submit
The tokens row is fail and its evidence cites form.tsx:19 or form.tsx:20 and at least one of #ccc, #1d4ed8 or #fff
The consistency row is fail and its evidence cites form.tsx:18-21: the <style> element restyles every input and button in the document, or the submit is a one-off styled button
The a11y row is fail and its evidence cites form.tsx:19: the #ccc input border is under the 3:1 non-text contrast line
The states row is fail and its evidence cites form.tsx:9-13: the response is never checked, so there is no error state and no success confirmation
The interaction row is fail and its evidence cites form.tsx:19 (outline: none with no focus-visible replacement)
The interaction fix restores a visible keyboard focus style such as a :focus-visible outline, not only deleting outline: none
